title: RBI Raises Bank Dividend Payout Cap to 75% of PAT
summary: RBI proposes raising dividend payout ceiling for commercial banks from 40% to 75% of PAT effective FY2026-27.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Raises Bank Dividend Payout Cap to 75% of PAT. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI proposed lifting the maximum dividend payout ratio for commercial banks from **40% to 75% of Profit After Tax (PAT)**, governed by a 10-bucket CET1 capital strength matrix.
**Exclusions**: Excludes Small Finance Banks, Payments Banks, RRBs, and Local Area Banks.
**Adjusted PAT Formula**: PAT minus net NPAs as of 31 March.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on maximum dividend payout cap (75% of PAT) and minimum net NPA eligibility criterion (< 6%).

blocks.title: 💼 Interview Question & Model Answer
blocks.text:
**Q:** How does linking commercial bank dividend payouts to net NPA ratios enhance banking resilience?

**Model Answer:** It ensures capital preservation by requiring banks with weaker asset quality to retain internal earnings rather than depleting reserves via cash payouts.
